bridge.pageIntro: Move USDC you already hold on Ethereum or Polygon onto Stellar, so you can donate it to a climate project without buying a second token.
bridge.whatIsTitle: What this bridge does for GreenPay
bridge.whatIsBody: GreenPay donations are made with Stellar-native assets, but most people hold USDC on Ethereum or Polygon. This bridge closes that gap: your USDC is burned on the source chain and an equal amount is minted as native Stellar USDC, so the money you already have becomes money you can donate.
bridge.howIsBody: GreenPay uses Circle's Cross-Chain Transfer Protocol (CCTP) — the protocol run by the issuer of USDC itself. Because the transfer is a burn-and-mint, there is no wrapped token, no liquidity pool and no bridge operator holding your funds in escrow. GreenPay never takes custody: you approve the transfer in your own wallet and the USDC lands directly at your Stellar address.
bridge.doesList1: Reads your Ethereum USDC balance, read-only, so you can see what is available to move
bridge.doesList2: Opens Circle's bridge pre-filled with your Stellar address as the destination
bridge.doesList3: Records a transfer you have already completed as a donation to a project you choose
bridge.doesNotList1: Hold or custody your funds at any point
bridge.doesNotList2: Charge a bridge fee — CCTP burns and mints at par, so the amount arrives unchanged
bridge.doesNotList3: Convert fiat. This moves crypto you already own; it is not a cash on-ramp or off-ramp
bridge.fiatNote: Need to buy USDC with a bank card, or cash out afterwards? That is a fiat on/off-ramp (a Stellar anchor such as SEP-24 deposit and withdrawal) and it is planned but not built yet. See the Roadmap for the current status.
bridge.installMetaMask: MetaMask was not detected. Install it to read your Ethereum USDC balance.
bridge.step1Desc: Connect MetaMask to see how much USDC you have available to bridge. This step only reads your balance.
bridge.step2Desc: Connect Freighter so we know which Stellar address should receive the USDC.
bridge.step3Desc: We open Circle's CCTP interface in a new tab with your Stellar address and the network you picked already filled in.
bridge.step4Desc: Follow Circle's instructions to approve and confirm. The USDC is minted on Stellar and is ready to donate.
bridge.recordDesc: Once the USDC has arrived in your Stellar wallet, record it here so the amount shows up against the project you chose.
bridge.aboutCctpBody: Circle's Cross-Chain Transfer Protocol is a permissionless on-chain messaging protocol that moves native USDC between blockchains without wrapping it or routing it through a liquidity pool. Your USDC is burned on the source chain and minted on the destination chain, which is what keeps the 1:1 peg intact across chains.
